svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 104 x 62 mm from 2 mm sheet; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.4 mm holes for the floor pads: 8 and 96 mm from the rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, 24 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 2.7 mm holes for the Pi spacers, on the Pi 4's 58 x 49 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pattern: 9.5 and 67.5 mm from the rear edge, 24.5 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Also cut the deck: 68 x 56 mm, 2 mm sheet or a printed plate, with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: same Pi pattern 3.5 mm in from its rear and side edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M3 x 6 screws into the floor pads; the Pi sits on 4 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spacers; the deck on 20 mm M2.5 standoffs above the Pi.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A thermal pad between the Pi's heat sink and the deck or tray gives

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the heat path to the hull.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tray drops in past the rim (64 mm opening) without force.
